entries.title: Romans 15:1
segments: Then we who are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

entries.title: Romans 15:2
segments: Let every one of us please [his] neighbor for [his] good, to building up.

entries.title: Romans 15:3
segments: For even Christ did not please Himself; but as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached You fell on Me."

entries.title: Romans 15:4
segments: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, so that we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope.

entries.title: Romans 15:5
segments: And may the God of patience and consolation grant you to be like minded toward one another according to Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Romans 15:6
segments: so that with one mind [and] one mouth you may glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Romans 15:7
segments: Therefore receive one another as Christ also received us, to [the] glory of God.

entries.title: Romans 15:8
segments: And I say, Jesus Christ has become a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises [made] to the fathers,

entries.title: Romans 15:9
segments: and that the nations might glorify God for [His] mercy, as it is written, "For this cause I will confess to You in the nations, and I will praise Your name."

entries.title: Romans 15:10
segments: And again He says, "Rejoice, O nations, with His people."

entries.title: Romans 15:11
segments: And again, "Praise the Lord, all the nations, and praise Him, all the peoples."

entries.title: Romans 15:12
segments: And again Isaiah says, "There shall be a root of Jesse, and He who shall rise to reign over the nations, in Him shall the nations trust."

entries.title: Romans 15:13
segments: And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope through the power of [the] Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 15:14
segments: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brothers, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

entries.title: Romans 15:15
segments: But, brothers, I wrote to you boldly, as reminding you in part, because of the grace that is given to me by God,

entries.title: Romans 15:16
segments: that I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the nations, ministering the gospel of God, so that the offering up of the nations might be acceptable, being sanctified by [the] Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 15:17
segments: Therefore I have boasting in Christ Jesus [as to] the things pertaining to God.

entries.title: Romans 15:18
segments: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ did not work out by me for [the] obedience of the nations in word and deed,

entries.title: Romans 15:19
segments: in power of miracles and wonders, in power of [the] Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem, and all around to Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: Romans 15:20
segments: Yea, so I have been eager to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build on another man's foundation;

entries.title: Romans 15:21
segments: but as it is written, "To whom nothing was said about Him, they shall see. And they who have not heard shall understand."

entries.title: Romans 15:22
segments: For this cause I also have been greatly hindered from coming to you.

entries.title: Romans 15:23
segments: But now, having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come to you,

entries.title: Romans 15:24
segments: whenever I may go into Spain, I will come to you. For [in] traveling through I hope to see you, and to be set forward there by you, if first I may be filled of you in part.

entries.title: Romans 15:25
segments: But now I am going to Jerusalem to minister to the saints.

entries.title: Romans 15:26
segments: For it has pleased those of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Romans 15:27
segments: Truly it has pleased them, and they are their debtors. For if the nations have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister to them in carnal things.

entries.title: Romans 15:28
segments: Therefore when I have completed this, and have sealed this fruit to them, I will come by you into Spain.

entries.title: Romans 15:29
segments: And I am sure that when I come to you, I shall come in the fullness of [the] blessing of the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: Romans 15:30
segments: But I exhort you, brothers, for the sake of the Lord Jesus Christ and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in [your] prayers to God for me,

entries.title: Romans 15:31
segments: that I may be delivered from those disbelieving in Judea, and that my service which [I have] for Jerusalem may be accepted by the saints;

entries.title: Romans 15:32
segments: so that [I may] come to you with joy by [the] will of God, and may be refreshed with you.

entries.title: Romans 15:33
segments: Now may the God of peace [be] with you all. Amen.
